symbols.name: first bit
symbols.meaning: A bit, a value 0 or 1, the first operand of the exclusive or.
symbols.quote: For bits $\sigma$ and $\sigma'$, the exclusive or $\sigma \oplus \sigma'$ is their bitwise sum modulo 2, which is 1 exactly when the bits differ.

symbols.name: second bit
symbols.meaning: A bit, a value 0 or 1, the second operand of the exclusive or.
symbols.quote: For bits $\sigma$ and $\sigma'$, the exclusive or $\sigma \oplus \sigma'$ is their bitwise sum modulo 2, which is 1 exactly when the bits differ.

relations.quote: XOR is a step inside the [Address-field interchange](address-interchange.md), which swaps two disjoint fields of address bits.
So a sequence of XOR steps can produce a [Permutation](permutation.md) of the data, a rearrangement in which each value lands at exactly one position.
XOR is the only gate of the [Bit network](bit-network.md).

relations.predicate: is computed at each address by
relations.quote: XOR is computed at each address by a [Gate and terminal of a network](network-gate-terminal.md), which combines the two bits stored at that address by a fixed linear map.
